For each task, we measured models' accuracy on percept (P), belief (B), and intention (I) questions. We then computed two scores: the PB score, which requires correctly answering percept and belief questions (P ∧ B), and the PBI score, which requires correctly answering all three question types (P ∧ B ∧ I).
